metadata.title: H3AT 2020 measured afternoon air temperatures near NRG Park
metadata.attribution: CAPA Strategies; Houston Advanced Research Center; Houston Harris Heat Action Team
metadata.limitation: Historical mobile-sensor street observations on a single day. Not a current forecast, not land-surface temperature, not canopy or corridor shade measurements. Points are spatially autocorrelated; summary is a sample summary, not an area-wide average. Do not extrapolate into unsampled stadium interior.
